initialization: Fresh official SAM2 Hiera weights for every formal run; never continue a previously trained Kvasir model or a smoke model.
artifacts: Independent output roots per GPU and unique run IDs per model and seed; retain the original three checkpoints, source hashes, runtime override patch, effective commands, environment and original evaluation logs.
evaluation_scope: The official120 are used for early stopping/checkpoint selection and reporting; no separate independent third test set.
implementation: Reuse tools/run_experiment.py with optional split-dir, epochs, patience and fp32 arguments; no dedicated study training loop or distribution archive.
rtx5070ti_scheduling: Wait for already-authorized Polyper80k, old paper-recipe queue and final audit to complete and their recorded processes to exit. Then run eighteen experiments through the original launcher.
rtx3090_scheduling: Synchronize through Git; user runs the original single-experiment launcher or convenience shell loop for eighteen runs.
history: Preserve all original splits, experiment definitions, results and checkpoints.
failure_policy: Stop on failure, changed queued sources or existing output; do not automatically lower precision, reduce batch, change models or repeat failed runs.
